also_measured: NEITHER arm produces usable chemistry on gsk3b: 0/10 above QED 0.6 and 0/10 below SA 4.0 in both arms. gsk3b at 250 calls yields no drug-like molecules regardless of memory.
consequence: The gsk3b 0.530 is NOT a reportable result and must not enter any promotion comparison. It measures exploitation of a fingerprint predictor, not molecular design.
contrast: On celecoxib_rediscovery -- a similarity objective that cannot be fooled this way -- the same mechanism is a genuine win (AUC 0.2489 -> 0.3138, +26.1%). The honest statement is that online memory improves SEARCH, and on a foolable objective it searches harder toward the exploit.
finding: B scores 29% higher on the oracle while its top-10 are chemically WORSE than A's -- lower QED, higher SA -- and memory strengthens the score/unsynthesizability coupling from +0.456 to +0.668. B's top molecules carry phosphorus in aromatic rings (n1cpcc21, cpcn) and hypervalent iodine ([IH]).
implication_for_the_panel: A heterogeneous PMO panel must report per-task CHEMISTRY alongside score. A suite mean over tasks of mixed foolability would have hidden this entirely -- gsk3b's +36.8% AUC would have been averaged in as progress.
method: Read every charged query result from each arm's durable ledger and scored QED and SA under the pinned kernel (rdkit 2024.3.5) with the repo's own sascorer. Zero oracle calls; no molecule was re-scored by the oracle.
question: gsk3b is the oracle where reward hacking was MEASURED. Does online structural memory SUPPRESS the off-manifold drift, or AMPLIFY it by remembering that garbage scored well?
